name: gap_reversal_volume_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY opens with an overnight gap (>0.3%), the first 1-2 minutes of 5-second bars reveal institutional contra-positioning through volume microstructure: if NIFTY gapped down yet most 5-second bars in the opening minute close above their opens (positive cumulative bar pressure), and session OBV is rising despite the gap-down price, VWAP-benchmarked institutional buyers are accumulating aggressively at sub-benchmark prices. This contra-volume signal — buying into a gap-down, or selling into a gap-up — precedes price reversal by 60-90 seconds as institutional flows progressively overwhelm gap-direction momentum. We enter when bar pressure plus rising OBV both confirm the contra-flow, while price remains on the wrong side of VWAP (confirming the reversal has not yet been fully priced in).
core_signal_oneliner: Gap 0.3-1.5% day: OBV rising and net bar pressure opposing gap direction within 1 minute of open, while price still on gap-direction side of VWAP
